content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-1. - Title.
content.summary:
This article shall be known as the "Local Improvements Law."
(Code 1981, § 27-1; Ord. No. 551, § 1, 5-14-1964)
Charter reference—
Initiative and referendum, §
5.13
; municipal borrowing, § 11.1 et seq.
